Product Features

  • 2-piece set: Two round coffee tables in different sizes for versatile uses.
  • High-gloss marble look: Both table tops coated with an elegant, high-gloss marble look.
  • Extra storage: The smaller table has two drawers, ideal for storing small items.
  • High load capacity: Both tables can carry up to 30kg each, sturdy and stable.
  • Flexible design: Tables can be used together as a set or individually, depending on your needs.
  • Versatile: Perfect for living rooms or other living areas, suitable for any interior style.
  • Modern Design: Timeless design that adds an elegant touch to any room.
  • The tabletop is made of a high-gloss marble pattern, not marble stone slabs.
  • The cylinder of the small table is made of plastic and the table tops of both tables are made of MDF

Descriptions

Combining modern design with practical functionality, this sophisticated coffee table set is a stylish addition to any living room. The set consists of two round tables in different sizes: the large table is 60*60*46 cm long and the small table is 50*50*31 cm long. The table tops of both tables are coated with a high-gloss marble pattern, which adds luxury and timeless splendour to any room. The smaller table is equipped with two practical drawers that provide additional storage space. These drawers are perfect for storing remote controls, magazines, or other small items that need to be easily accessible but still organized. Depending on your needs, both tables can be used either as a harmonious set or individually in different areas of your home. Both tables are very stable and resilient. With a load capacity of 30 kg per tabletop, they are robust and reliable everyday furniture. Thanks to their flexible design and elegant simplicity, these This coffee table set not only offers a practical storage surface, but also an aesthetically pleasing solution for stylish living. With its high-quality workmanship and timeless design, it is the perfect choice for those who value quality and functionality.
